evoluon.name: Evoluon
evoluon.slogan: A flying saucer that landed in a Dutch suburb.
evoluon.line: Opened in 1966 as a Philips science museum, its concrete dome is 77 metres across.

vanabbe.name: Van Abbemuseum
vanabbe.slogan: Where a cigar baron's collection turned into modern art.
vanabbe.line: It holds one of the largest collections of El Lissitzky paintings in the world.

nuenen.name: Van Gogh's Nuenen
nuenen.slogan: Lanes and lamplight where Vincent found his peasants.
nuenen.line: These people eating potatoes by the light of their lamp have dug the earth with the self-same hands.
nuenen.by: Vincent van Gogh, letter to Theo from Nuenen, c. 30 April 1885

strijps.name: Strijp-S
strijps.slogan: Old Philips halls, now full of lofts, design and noise.
strijps.line: Philips built its first factory here in 1916, a glassworks for light bulbs, and left by 2006.

philips.name: Philips Lightbulb Factory
philips.slogan: Where one small bulb lit up a whole city.
philips.line: Gerard and Frederik Philips founded the company in Eindhoven on 15 May 1891 to make incandescent lamps.
